title: Levenda's Unholy Alliance on Nazis and the Nordic tall whites

tellings.quote: you know, he writes about this unholy alliance where he talks about the Nazis, you know, uh, sort of, uh, aligning themselves with the tall whites of the Nordics and there being some sort of secret technology.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, describes Unholy Alliance, a book by the author Peter Levenda about Nazi Germany in the 1930s and 1940s. According to Michels, Levenda writes that the Nazis aligned themselves with the "tall whites" or "Nordics," tall, pale, human-looking beings described in some UFO stories, and that some kind of secret technology was involved. If true, it would mean non-human beings shaped one of history's darkest regimes.
